content.text: Goal: make the sky warmer and add sunset light.
<|refl_start|><problem>The sky is still flat and lacks warm highlights.</problem><fix>Increase warm tones, add rim light, and keep subject details.</fix><|refl_end|>
Goal: convert daytime scene into moody rainy evening.
<|refl_start|><problem>Lighting remains too bright and dry.</problem><fix>Darken global exposure, add rain streaks, wet reflections, and cool color temperature.</fix><|refl_end|>
